name: flash-games
description: Static browser player for .swf games powered by self-hosted Ruffle.
author: Ruslan Khasanshin

scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix || oxlint --fix; stylelint --max-warnings 0 --fix --ignore-path .gitignore 'styles/**/*.css' && bun fmt && oxlint
scripts.check:all: bun lint && bun check:hooks && bun check:workflows && bun check:types && bun check:unused && bun check:vulns && bun check:offline
scripts.prepare: if [ -n "${CI:-}" ] || [ "${LEFTHOOK:-}" = "0" ]; then exit 0; fi; lefthook install
scripts.serve: bun run build && bun -e 'const server = Bun.serve({ development: false, hostname: "127.0.0.1", routes: { "/*": { dir: "dist" } } }); console.log(server.url.href);'
